prior_evidence.use: The prior endpoint result motivates a fresh-seed mediation follow-up. No threshold, state, forcing path or endpoint is tuned from mediator outcomes.

exact_headroom_theorem.definition: H_tj = d_tj*q_tj - theta_t - logit(0.625)/4.5 in the q-only closure
exact_headroom_theorem.route_equivalence: H_tj > 0 iff q_(t+1,j) > 0.625 iff deterministic high-allele log-odds selection is positive.
exact_headroom_theorem.claim_boundary: H is an exact one-step route coordinate in the declared closure, not assumed to be sufficient for final realised-trait loss.

question: Does the resolved local q-dependent allele-selection edge create the late AA functional advantage by maintaining deeper last-refuge branch headroom through the demographic-density feedback path?

replication.common_random_number_pairing: AA and RR share one trajectory seed within each condition and master-seed/replicate key; the same paired key is reused across baseline and deletion conditions.
replication.seed_exclusion: The twelve master seeds are absent from the prior pathway-edge and focused single-edge protocols.

primary_endpoint.definition: Existing tau_trait_realised endpoint: first generation with realised high-trait occupancy absent from every patch.
primary_endpoint.success_rule: The paired 95% CI for DID_loss40 must lie strictly above zero. Otherwise endpoint replication is unresolved and the mediation claim stops.

primary_mediator.metric: maximum patchwise pre-update branch headroom H across the four patches
primary_mediator.success_rule: The paired 95% CI for DID_H20 must lie strictly above zero. This horizon is fixed because it precedes the generation-40 endpoint and was not selected after mediator outcomes.

secondary_readouts: AA-RR number of patches with H>0 at generations 5,10,20,40
first generation at which all four patches have H<0, reported descriptively with censoring retained
generation-20 functional-loss DID as a secondary endpoint replication
decision_rule: Call the headroom pathway prospectively supported only if both the primary generation-40 loss DID and the primary generation-20 max-headroom DID have paired 95% intervals strictly above zero. Otherwise retain the pathway as unresolved. This is mechanistic pathway evidence, not a formal natural-system mediation estimand.
stop_rule: Run exactly the two declared conditions, AA/RR assignments, twelve fresh master seeds, 500 replicates per seed, fixed forcing, exact H=0 surface and existing functional-loss endpoint. Do not add seeds, alternative headroom thresholds, alternative primary horizons, alternative endpoint definitions, migration, mutation or new interventions after the first outcome file is generated.
claim_boundary: A positive result supports selection-to-headroom-to-fate propagation only in the declared finite q-only closure. It does not make H a sufficient universal predictor, does not identify a natural threshold, and does not replace the already resolved single-edge causal proof.
